title: Jumio Android SDK v4.18.0
impact_summary: SDK now requires a minimum Android OS level of 24, affecting applications targeting lower versions.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must update its Android projects to target minSdk 24 to use the updated Jumio SDK.

title: SMS Delivery Failures from a Subset of Twilio Long Codes to Iliad Italy

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: Twilio SendGrid has removed the Send to Coworker action from Domain Authentication, eliminating the option to send DNS updates via email.
backbase_rationale: Backbase integrations using this action must be updated to avoid failures.

title: Verify tightens fraud prevention geo permissions for Italy and Argentina
impact_summary: Twilio Verify will automatically change the default geo permission for Italy and Argentina to "Monitor all traffic for fraud," requiring Fraud Guard to be enabled.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must review compliance with updated fraud protection requirements in these regions.
